These tiny KiCad projects are generated by `build_fixture.py`. They use a
self-contained one-pin symbol and footprint, with stable UUIDs. No library,
network, model, or project code is needed. `clean` has a no-connect marker;
`broken` removes it, changes the footprint value, and adds crossing tracks on
different nets. `routing` adds only the crossing tracks. This is controlled
checker evidence, not a manufacturable circuit.
